officialChanges.text: Hajin is BR; Zodiac is Resurgence. Mixed-mode reports cannot become picks in both without actual map/mode evidence.
Current registry: 33 MW4 launch guns plus Cronen Osprey and CSG-35 at S1 launch. Recurring names need current-MW4 compatibility validation.
Legacy guns are Gunsmith-locked presets / blueprints. Old attachments are historical, not editable Season 1 builds.
Cronen Osprey is BP16 and CSG-35 BP36. Adoption is constrained by access and early lockout this launch day.
Visible Combat Record / Leaderboards arrive in S2. No official population usage statistic supports a launch-day winner.
TrueGameData said full WZ stats were in progress at 1:46 p.m. ET Nov 6. No finished dataset was found by this audit cutoff.
Afternoon official-feed check found no weapon-balance hotfix. Current incidents concern camos/skins/DMZ transitions.

changelog.title: Cronen Osprey
changelog.text: Cronen Osprey jumps to 11 of 29 tracked pros (from 7), including Hisoka, who dropped the Han 86. Han 86 now has no tracked pro and is marked a watch.

changelog.title: KG-7 Vulcan
changelog.text: KG-7 Vulcan named BR long-range sniper pick (Testing); Mosin moved to alternative for medium-range quick-scoping.

changelog.title: Mosin-Nagant
changelog.text: Mosin-Nagant added to BR Sniper (Testing) from Fifakill's build.

changelog.title: Build tabs
changelog.text: Build tabs; aggregator builds added where no pro loadout exists. Competitive recipes are tabbed on the card, pro evidence first. A slot the source does not list stays unknown.

changelog.title: Multi-gun role cards, TTK section, Mineral Ledger redesign
changelog.text: Close range now groups a VEL 46 meta pick with ISO Nightshade and Wz.55 Striga as testing alternatives. ISO has no attachments: JGOD’s Nov 6 calculation is faster inside 15m and WZStats ranks it #1 close range, but no pro loadout was seen. Striga stays build-unverified and mode-unverified; Swagg calls it the fastest-killing SMG, and the JGOD and CODMunity calculators are charted separately. Cronen Osprey, Han 86, and Voyak stay single picks. Sniper and every Resurgence role stay empty. The TTK section labels calculator values CALC and does not merge the two sources’ buckets.

changelog.title: VEL versus ISO: usage is not faster TTK
changelog.text: Kept VEL Emerging but made the disagreement explicit: rolling-panel usage and direct Hisoka Hajin BR footage support VEL as a candidate; Swagg describes comfort/movement. JGOD’s launch-day calculations favor ISO at 0m and 15m, while VEL leads at 40m. These are calculations, not controlled tests. Hisoka’s readable four-part observation is separate from Spam’s build; fifth slot remains unverified.

changelog.title: Current-game-only cleanup
changelog.text: 10 of 11 prior role cards were removed from recommendation status; Cronen was the only current build retained after name/capture verification. Nine recommendations were withdrawn completely, while Voyak stays as one visible current-use Legacy exception without any attachment recipe. Prior 45 displayed rows across seven distinct recipes became 14 rows across three current MW4 recipes. An explicit sniper gap and Zodiac evidence gap are left empty. Historical values are retained in the local audit, not the recommendation table.

changelog.title: Dated-data and compatibility audit
changelog.text: FLS’s four-part ISO remains Nov 3; Hisoka’s former VEL list has old-game strings; the former KG-7/Astaroth entry is a pre-launch editorial build, not current pro evidence.
